name: wrath-of-elune-cooldown|Wrath of Elune cuts Sentinel Glaive's cooldown by 5 sec (#2397)
contract: Wrath of Elune 704786 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32, passive 0x1c0) carries SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (11), EffectSpellClassMask word2 0x20000000 and EffectBasePoints -5001, resolving to -5000 with DieSides 1, matching 'Reduces the cooldown of Sentinel Glaive by $/1000;s1 sec'. Sentinel Glaive 800506 has SpellFamilyFlags word2 0x20000000, RecoveryTime 15000 and CategoryRecoveryTime 15000, and no SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS (0x20000000 in AttributesEx3) nor SPELL_ATTR6_NO_CATEGORY_COOLDOWN_MODS. Native path only: Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to both recovery fields through Player::ApplySpellMod, and SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod admits the modifier on the shared family and mask. The spell_modifier metric runs that same ApplySpellMod on the shipped 15000 ms: 15000 - 5000 = 10000. Astral Blade 805563 (word2 0x200000, RecoveryTime 20000) has a different mask and must stay at 20000. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Sentinel Glaive cooldown is unmodified without the talent
Sentinel Glaive cooldown drops to 10 sec with the talent
Astral Blade cooldown is not touched by the talent
